motivation: A post-open factorial localized Chamfer accuracy to the released dense observation field and manual-track accuracy to sparse material-identity anchors. This control asks whether frame-zero query association plus causal CoTracker3 motion can replace later manual anchor observations.
claim_boundary: The 22 cases and the one-case single_lift_sloth smoke outcome were already open before this protocol.
Frame-zero manual query coordinates are label input, so this is not a label-free or deployable Bayesian-PhysTwin result.
No manual position after frame zero may enter association, fitting, selection, or prediction.
Released manual trajectories after frame zero are evaluation-only.
No full-cohort outcome may select thresholds, change the candidate grid, or support confirmation or a state-of-the-art claim.
fixed_semantics: Associate each finite frame-zero query to its nearest original PhysTwin node using frame-zero geometry only.
Use the corresponding CoTracker3 multiview trajectory for every later sparse-anchor update.
Use the released dense pseudo-tracks for the dense discrepancy channel.
Process CoTracker innovations once through the existing robust mixture endpoint.
Use exact baseline fallback when the causal prefix selector rejects an update.

decision.crosses_8mm_15mm: Evidence that causal automatic tracking is adequate once query association is supplied; automatic query discovery remains unresolved.
decision.misses_track_threshold: CoTracker support or endpoint accuracy remains inadequate even with oracle frame-zero association.
decision.misses_chamfer_threshold: The sparse anchor path interferes with the dense geometry channel and requires a decoupled readout or covariance-aware merge.
